behaviour: For a retained beat draft that conflicts with changed source, show Conflict with source, the current source text, and the editable draft in the selected-beat sidebar.
Place Discard draft and Override source together below the draft text box.
Discard draft keeps the source text and discards only this beat draft.
Override source validates and saves only the selected beat with the editor text. Other beat drafts remain unsaved. Empty input refuses the override and keeps the draft.
Mark the conflicted beat without interrupting unrelated work. Unrelated non-conflicting saved changes need no prompt.
An unresolved conflict blocks the main Story Save, reveals the affected beat and retains all drafts without saving any of them.
Navigation and Tracks/Reel changes retain drafts. Valid drafts preview on the game stage; the normal Save status reports unsaved work.
deviations: The mock uses fictional, memory-only data. It does not implement source transactions, persistent saving, recovery, history or SDK execution. Production must preserve the existing transactional checks.
Only beats 05 and 07 are editable. Other beats, workspace icons and the Branch path provide context.
The reviewed prototype toolbar and catalog description still contain pre-approval wording. The Design Lab approval record owns the actual design status; those strings are prototype scaffolding.
